column1: # BMF letters and official form instructions. Columns, separated by tabs:
# id, kind, years, date, reference, title, source, url, download, sha256
# kind is letter or instructions. years is one year or a range such as 2023-2026.
# reference is the Geschäftszeichen of a letter, or - for a form instruction.
# source is the Bundessteuerblatt page of a letter, or the menu path of a form instruction.
# download is direct when the url gives the file, or browser when the owner must download it.
# Each file is law/guidance/<id>.pdf. scripts/guidance.sh fetch --pin fills an empty sha256.
